'''2006 World Championship Day 2/3 Greg Shaw LS Careful Planning (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2006 World Championship]] (Day 2/3); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Scott "CRingwell" Lingrell (2006-10-23).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35750 Cartman - Worlds Day 2/3 Deck]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20070211003221/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35750&PHPSESSID=84d2b1152e98cb77a826b3278db9feed Internet Archive]</ref>

'''Note:''' Base list posted by designer Scott Lingrell; Shaw's Day 2/3 changes are not included ("the changes aren't here").<ref name="src" />
